main_theorem.statement_math: \text{Let }x^*\text{ be an optimal solution of (8.3.6), the parameters }\{\lambda_t\}\text{ and }\{\beta_t\}\text{ in the CS procedure of Algorithm 8.8 be set as (8.3.34),\text{ and suppose that }\{\alpha_k\},\{\theta_k\},\{\eta_k\},\{\tau_k\}\text{ and }\{T_k\}\text{ are set to }\alpha_k=\theta_k=1,\quad \eta_k=2\|\mathcal{L}\|,\quad \tau_k=\|\mathcal{L}\|,\quad \text{and }T_k=\left\lceil\frac{m(M^2+\sigma^2)N}{\|\mathcal{L}\|^2\widetilde{D}}\right\rceil,\quad \forall k=1,\ldots,N,\text{ for some }\widetilde{D}>0.\text{ Then, under Assumptions (8.3.61) and (8.3.62), we have for any }N\ge1\quad \mathbb{E}[F(\hat{x}_k)-F(x^*)]\le\frac{\|\mathcal{L}\|}{N}\left[3V(x_0,x^*)+\frac{1}{2}\|y_0\|^2+4\widetilde{D}\right],\quad \mathbb{E}[\|\mathcal{L}\hat{x}_N\|]\le\frac{\|\mathcal{L}\|}{N}\left[3\sqrt{6V(x_0,x^*)+8\widetilde{D}}+4\|y^*-y_0\|\right],\quad \text{where }\hat{x}_N=\frac{1}{N}\sum_{k=1}^N\hat{x}_k,\text{ and }y^*\text{ is an arbitrary dual optimal solution.}

key_lemmas.name: PerturbedGapToResidualsProposition86
key_lemmas.statement_math: \text{For any }Y\subset\mathbb{R}^{md}\text{ such that }0\in Y,\text{ if }g_Y(\mathcal{L}x,z)\le \epsilon<\infty\text{ and }\|\mathcal{L}x\|\le \delta,\text{ where }z=(x,y)\in X\times\mathbb{R}^{md},\text{ then }x\text{ is an }(\epsilon,\delta)\text{-solution of (8.3.6). In particular, when }Y=\mathbb{R}^{md},\text{ for any }s\text{ such that }g(s,z)\le\epsilon<\infty\text{ and }\|s\|\le\delta,\text{ we always have }s=\mathcal{L}x.

key_lemmas.name: ProjectionLemma35
key_lemmas.statement_math: \text{Let the convex function }p:X\to\mathbb{R},\text{ the points }\tilde{x},\tilde{y}\in X,\text{ and the scalars }\mu_1,\mu_2\ge0\text{ be given. Let }\nu:X\to\mathbb{R}\text{ be a differentiable convex function and }V(x,z)\text{ be defined in (3.2.2). If }\hat{u}\in\operatorname{Argmin}\{p(u)+\mu_1V(\tilde{x},u)+\mu_2V(\tilde{y},u):u\in X\},\text{ then for any }u\in X,\ p(\hat{u})+\mu_1V(\tilde{x},\hat{u})+\mu_2V(\tilde{y},\hat{u})\le p(u)+\mu_1V(\tilde{x},u)+\mu_2V(\tilde{y},u)-(\mu_1+\mu_2)V(\hat{u},u).

key_lemmas.statement_math: \text{If }\{\beta_t\}\text{ and }\{\lambda_t\}\text{ in the CS procedure satisfy }\lambda_{t+1}(\eta\beta_{t+1}-\mu)\le \lambda_t(1+\beta_t)\eta,\ \forall t\ge1,\text{ then, for }t\ge1\text{ and }u\in U,\ (\sum_{t=1}^T\lambda_t)^{-1}\left[\eta(1+\beta_T)\lambda_TV(u_T,u)+\sum_{t=1}^T\lambda_t\langle\delta^{t-1},u-u_{t-1}\rangle+\Phi(\hat{u}_T)-\Phi(u)\right]\le (\sum_{t=1}^T\lambda_t)^{-1}\left[(\eta\beta_1-\mu)\lambda_1V(u_0,u)+\sum_{t=1}^T\frac{(M+\|\delta^{t-1}\|_*)^2\lambda_t}{2\eta\beta_t}\right].

key_lemmas.name: GeneralSDCSGapLemma85
key_lemmas.statement_math: \text{Let the iterates }(\hat{x}_k,y_k)\text{ for }k=1,\ldots,N\text{ be generated by Algorithm 8.8, }\hat{z}_N:=\left(\sum_{k=1}^N\theta_k\right)^{-1}\sum_{k=1}^N\theta_k(\hat{x}_k,y_k),\text{ and Assumptions (8.3.61)-(8.3.62) hold. If the objective }f_i,i=1,\ldots,m,\text{ are general nonsmooth convex functions, i.e., }\mu=0\text{ and }M>0,\text{ let the parameters }\{\alpha_k\},\{\theta_k\},\{\eta_k\},\{\tau_k\},\text{ and }\{T_k\}\text{ in Algorithm 8.8 satisfy (8.3.29)-(8.3.33),\text{ and the parameters }\{\lambda_t\}\text{ and }\{\beta_t\}\text{ in the CS procedure of Algorithm 8.8 be set as (8.3.34). Then, for all }z\in X\times\mathbb{R}^{md},\quad Q(\hat{z}_N;z)\le\left(\sum_{k=1}^N\theta_k\right)^{-1}\left[\frac{(T_1+1)(T_1+2)\theta_1\eta_1}{T_1(T_1+3)}V(x_0,x)+\frac{\theta_1\tau_1}{2}\|y_0\|^2+\langle\hat{s},y\rangle+\sum_{k=1}^N\sum_{t=1}^{T_k}\sum_{i=1}^m\frac{2\theta_k}{T_k(T_k+3)}\left((t+1)\langle\delta_i^{t-1,k},x_i-u_i^{t-1}\rangle+\frac{4(M^2+\|\delta_i^{t-1,k}\|_*^2)}{\eta_k}\right)\right],\quad \text{where }\hat{s}:=\theta_N\mathcal{L}(\hat{x}_N-x_{N-1})+\theta_1\tau_1(y_N-y_0)\text{ and }Q\text{ is defined in (8.3.8). Furthermore, for any saddle point }(x^*,y^*)\text{ of (8.3.7), we have }\quad \frac{\theta_N}{2}\left(1-\frac{\theta_N\|\mathcal{L}\|^2}{\eta_N\tau_N}\right)\max\{\eta_N\|\hat{x}_N-x_{N-1}\|^2,\tau_N\|y^*-y_N\|^2\}\le\frac{(T_1+1)(T_1+2)\theta_1\eta_1}{T_1(T_1+3)}V(x_0,x^*)+\frac{\theta_1\tau_1}{2}\|y^*-y_0\|^2+\sum_{k=1}^N\sum_{t=1}^{T_k}\sum_{i=1}^m\frac{2\theta_k}{T_k(T_k+3)}\left((t+1)\langle\delta_i^{t-1,k},x_i^*-u_i^{t-1}\rangle+\frac{4(M^2+\|\delta_i^{t-1,k}\|_*^2)}{\eta_k}\right).
